messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — changelog cutoff for v1.8 is today 17:00 PT. Please add entries to CHANGELOG.md under 'Unreleased'. Use the release-notes template below. Also ensure your PR has a `release-note` label (or `release-note:pending`).

josh: ACK. where's the template so I can copy it into my PR?

marta: paste the snippet into the PR body or add to CHANGELOG.md. Example format (exact formatting matters for the linter):
```
### Added
- Short one-line description of the change. (PR #1234)

### Fixed
- Short one-line description of bugfix. (PR #1235)
```
Sections we expect: Added, Changed, Deprecated, Fixed, Security. Keep lines concise and include PR number.

sam: If something is super tiny (typo fix), do we still put it in CHANGELOG.md? I already mention it in the PR body.

marta: yes please — tiny fixes go under Fixed. The release pipeline aggregates CHANGELOG.md; if entries are missing they'll show up as "misc" and force manual edits during cut.

ci-bot: Reminder — PR #4579 does not have a `release-note` label. Please add one or CI will mark it for manual review.

naveen: I'll add the label to #4579 now.

leo: Also a branch coordination note: version bump should happen on the release branch `release/v1.8.0`, not directly on `main`. If you need the bump, open a small PR against the release branch.

josh: Who should run the release-note linter? I can do it locally but would prefer CI catch it early.

marta: we have `./scripts/lint-release-notes.sh`. Run `./scripts/lint-release-notes.sh CHANGELOG.md`. CI runs it on the release branch, but local check avoids last-minute fixes.

josh: Example of a bad entry I saw: `added new api endpoint for x -- see PR 4567`.

marta: Prefer this style: `- Added: new API endpoint for X. (PR #4567)` — start with section bullet, capitalized section name, concise sentence, PR in parentheses. No long prose.

release-manager: Plan: I'll cut `release/v1.8.0` at 18:00 PT if all CI green. Please freeze non-essential merges after 17:30 PT and confirm any urgent PRs with me.

marta: thanks. If you miss the cutoff, label PRs `post-release` and we'll roll them into the next patch.

leo: quick FYI — if the linter flags line length, the commit message may still pass but release notes will be reformatted. Try to keep lines < 120 chars.

naveen: done — #4579 labeled and changelog entry added.

josh: ran the linter locally, one fix pushed. :thumbsup:

marta: perfect. last ask: use exact section headings and include PR numbers. Minor deviations cause the auto-generator to drop entries. Thanks everyone!

ci-bot: Deploybot: scheduled release cutoff reminder set for 17:45 PT.

leo: I'll do a final pass first thing tomorrow AM if anything slips.

release-manager: Copy — see you all at cutoff. :rocket:
